name: eink-hub
description: Self-hosted control center for e-ink photo frames (BLOOMIN8, SwitchBot AI Art Frame, TRMNL firmware and your own ESP32 / Raspberry Pi frames), with Immich integration. Exact previews with smart crop, collections from uploads or Immich, schedules and battery-friendly pull mode. Set LOCAL_URL to http://[your Unraid IP]:8080: frames on your LAN use it to reach the hub, and "Search the network" scans its subnet. Then open the WebUI and choose an admin password. Documentation: https://eink-hub-7ba3a3.gitlab.io/guide/Unraid

ports.name: WebUI Port
ports.description: Web UI and the endpoints frames pull pictures from. If you change it, change LOCAL_URL too.

variables.name: LOCAL_URL
variables.description: LAN address of the hub, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:8080 (your Unraid IP and the port above). Frames use it to reach the hub; not localhost.

variables.name: ADMIN_PASSWORD
variables.description: Admin password. Leave empty to choose one on first visit.

variables.name: EXTERNAL_URL
variables.description: Optional address people use to open the hub (reverse proxy…). The QR code on the frames opens it.

variables.name: IMMICH_URL
variables.description: Optional Immich address, e.g. http://192.168.1.10:2283. Can also be set from Settings.

variables.name: IMMICH_API_KEY
variables.description: Optional Immich API key. Can also be set from Settings.

variables.name: CLOUD_URL
variables.description: Only for SwitchBot frames: public https address SwitchBot's cloud downloads photos from, when only /u/img is exposed. Empty = EXTERNAL_URL.

variables.name: AUTH_DISABLED
variables.description: true turns the admin password off. Only on a trusted network or behind your own auth proxy.
